Concept — actively in development

AUVEXIS PRODUCT

Auvexis Knowledge Accelerator

Local-first context preprocessing for AI agents.

The Auvexis Knowledge Accelerator is local-first software (with an optional future hardware component) that indexes, hashes, searches, compares, change-detects, deduplicates and filters local data — before it's handed to AI agents such as Codex, Claude Code, Claude Cowork or AYVIE.

View the architecture Go to the roadmap

PROBLEM

AI agents often process more context than necessary

The more local files, repositories and documents an AI agent has to search or load, the more redundant or unchanged context it processes along the way — even when that isn't always necessary.

That's exactly where the Auvexis Knowledge Accelerator comes in: a local-first preprocessing layer between your data and the AI agents that access it.

SOLUTION

Local-first preprocessing before context reaches an agent

Instead of handing raw data straight to an agent, the Knowledge Accelerator indexes and hashes local content, detects changes, deduplicates recurring content, and filters for relevance — designed to reduce redundant context processing.

Local-First

Data is processed locally, not sent to third parties by default.

Context Optimization

Preprocessing as the basis for more targeted, less redundant AI context.

Built transparently

No guaranteed metrics — results are published only once real benchmarking is complete.

ARCHITECTURE

How the Knowledge Accelerator works

A multi-stage, local-first processing path from raw data to optimized context.

01

Index

Local files, repositories and documents are captured in a structured way.

02

Hash

Content is hashed so states can be compared unambiguously.

03

Search & Compare

Content is searched and compared against known states.

04

Change Detection & Dedupe

Changes are detected, and unchanged or duplicate content is identified.

05

Filter & Reduce

Relevant content is filtered and reduced before being handed to AI agents.

LOCAL-FIRST

Your data stays local

The Auvexis Knowledge Accelerator is designed as a local-first system: processing happens on your own systems, not in an external cloud by default.

AI AGENT INTEGRATION

Preprocessed context for the agents you already use

The Knowledge Accelerator is designed as a preprocessing layer for common AI agents and environments — regardless of which agent ultimately receives the context.

Codex

Preprocessed, reduced context for Codex-based workflows.

Claude Code

Local-first context preparation for Claude Code sessions.

Claude Cowork

Structured context for Cowork workflows and automation.

AYVIE

Direct connection to AYVIE, the central internal operator and orchestration layer of Auvexis Systems.

Other workers

Open to additional AI agents and workers through a shared interface.

No official partnership with OpenAI, Anthropic, or other AI providers — integration refers to the technical connection to these tools.

HARDWARE ACCELERATION — PLANNED

Future Development

Hardware acceleration is a planned development path

Long-term, selected Knowledge Accelerator workloads — hashing, pattern matching, binary comparison, filtering and selected parallel processing steps — are intended to be accelerated by dedicated FPGA hardware.

This is currently a development path, not an available feature. No speed or efficiency promises are made before the corresponding analysis and prototypes exist.

  • Hashing
  • Pattern matching
  • Binary comparison
  • Filtering
  • Selected parallel workloads
